items.headline: Autodesk reports Q1 FY27 results; revenue up 18% Y/Y to $1.93B and announces deal to acquire MaintainX in ~$3.6B all-cash transaction
Autodesk to acquire MaintainX, advancing unified platform in operations and targeting over $135M ARR in 2026 with >50% growth
Autodesk Q1 FY27 earnings: EPS and revenue beat expectations; management highlights MaintainX acquisition as key growth driver
